newsitem.title: UK: Royal SunAlliance premium sales jumps.
newsitem.headline: Royal SunAlliance premium sales jumps.

text.p: Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc said its single premium sales rose over 113 percent to 778 million stg in 1996 from 365 million stg in 1995.
Royal & Sun Alliance said regular premium sales for the combined operation stood at 106 million stg, five percent more than 101 million in the previous year.
Royal & Sun Alliance merged its two UK life operations into a single marketing group, which was launched on January 1.
The group said single premium sales were boosted by demand for with-profit bonds, Sun Alliance's corporate bond PEP and a range of unit trusts.
